name: Diana DeGette
page_title: Diana DeGette's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Abortion bans are being used to deny women health care. And it’s why we must fight to restore Roe nationwide."
"I am disgusted, heartbroken, and furious that #RoevWade has been overturned. I promise that I will not stand idly by as the fight goes on. Reproductive rights are human rights!"
"Today we are holding a hearing to highlight the damage being done after #Roe was overturned. Tune in. These are important stories."

"ust one state banning abortion is too many. It’s not enough that it’ll remain legal in blue states – everyone deserves the right to bodily autonomy regardless of residence. We need Roe codified into federal law NOW."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "America's seniors deserve the secure retirement they've earned. I'm proud to be endorsed by the Alliance of Retired Americans. And I'll continue pushing to protect vital programs retirees rely on, like Medicare and Social Security."
"Do you support expanding federal funding to support entitlement programs such as Social Security and Medicare?" Yes."

"This week, I joined progressives in the House to reintroduce Medicare for All. We must boldly proclaim that health care is a human right and we must fight to make that vision a reality for the American people."
Voted in favor of S 610 "Protecting Medicare and American Farmers from Sequester Cuts Act"

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "In order to balance the budget, do you support an income tax increase on any tax bracket? Yes."

"Trump is already talking about another round of massive tax cuts for Wall Street and the wealthiest Americans if he’s elected this year. It’s clear who he’s fighting for and who he’ll prioritize as president."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "I'm co-sponsoring a bill to put an end to qualified immunity. A badge can no longer be a get-out-of-jail-free card. We must hold our law enforcement officers accountable. And NOW."
Voted in favor of HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "Do you support increasing defense spending? No."

"The Defense budget already encompasses over half of the discretionary budget. This per portion of spending is out of line with the needs in our nation for education, healthcare, housing, transportation, and other non defense spending priorities."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "Last night, I voted to pass a historic $1 trillion infrastructure bill and we secured an agreement to vote on the #BuildBackBetterAct in the coming weeks! These bills represent a once-in-a-generation opportunity to transform our nation for the better."
"Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth? Yes."
"For decades, our nation’s infrastructure was neglected. That changed when we passed the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to invest billions in rebuilding our crumbling roads, bridges, ports & more."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "This fight couldn't be more important, and I'm committed to doing everything I can to expand voting rights for all."

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)? Yes."
"I believe that the federal government must make a commitment to ensuring that we have net zero carbon emissions no later than 2050."

"The climate crisis is an existential threat to humanity. We’ve taken a great first step with the clean energy investments in The Inflation Reduction Act. Now, we must build on that success and push to go even further."
Voted in favor of HR 9 "Climate Action Now act"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government allowing permits for drilling on public lands?

evidence.text: "We must deal with climate change NOW. That's why in addition to our bill to protect millions of acres of public lands, I also reintroduced my bill to reduce methane emissions."
Voted in favor of HR 1146 "Arctic Cultural and Coastal Plain Protection Act"
Voted in favor of HR 823 "Colorado Outdoor Recreation and Economy Act"

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "Last week, House Democrats unveiled 3 discharge petitions — a legislative move that we’ll use to try to force a vote on the floor. These bills are all common-sense gun safety legislation that the American people support overwhelmingly."

"This is why it’s so urgent that we act on gun safety legislation. This issue is only getting worse and lives are on the line. I’ve introduced legislation to directly address rising gun violence and Congress should take up these bills immediately."
"Yesterday marked 24 years since Columbine and 24 years of inadequate action on gun violence. It’s unacceptable and I’m going to keep pushing until Congress passes meaningful gun safety legislation."
Rated 0% by the NRA

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "This week, I joined progressives in the House to reintroduce Medicare for All. We must boldly proclaim that health care is a human right and we must fight to make that vision a reality for the American people."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "We've added paid family and medical leave back into the #BuildBackBetterAct. RT if you agree that the US shouldn't be the ONLY industrialized nation in the world that doesn’t guarantee paid leave for workers."
Voted in favor of HR 6201 "Families First Coronavirus Response Act"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "This year, thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, the federal government was finally able to negotiate the price of prescription drugs. This will lower costs and save taxpayers billions."

"Prescription drug prices have had devastating impacts on folks across the country, including here in Colorado. I am committed to holding drug manufacturers accountable and lowering costs for everyday folks."

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: " Do you support the construction of a wall along the Mexican border? No."
Voted against HR 4760 "Securing America's Future Act of 2018"

positions.question: Do you support requiring immigrants to return to their country of origin before they are eligible for citizenship, regardless of their immigration status?
